keySentence: She always found good because she was kind.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna was a happy girl. She smiled every day. When bad things happened, she looked for the good part. She was always kind to everyone she met. She always found good because she was kind.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna moved to live with her strict Aunt Polly. Life was not easy, but Pollyanna never complained. She played the "Glad Game" — always finding something to be happy about. Even when people were rude, she saw the best in them. She always found good because she was kind at heart.
